L6-PDF1-p1.text:
108 Finger Permutations - Level 6
Odd-Count String-Skip Transfer: 3+1 / 1+3 Gap Control
Level 5 crossed one silent string after note 2. Level 6 moves the same skip to an odd beat, combining gap accuracy with asymmetrical pick timing.
1. Keep the map fixed
1 = index / fret 5
2 = middle / fret 6
3 = ring / fret 7
4 = pinky / fret 8
No position shift or wider skip yet.
2. Move the skip point
Mode A, 3+1: skip after note 3.
Mode B, 1+3: skip after note 1.
Ascend: E-D, A-G, D-B, G-e.
Descend: e-G, B-D, G-A, D-E.
3. Control the silent string
The string between source and target stays silent.
Accent the first note after each skip.
Repeat with both pick-start directions.
Balance tone and muting before adding speed.
Mode A example - code 1234
3+1: notes 1-2-3 on the source; clear one string; note 4 lands on the target.
e|--------|--------|--------|------8-|
B|--------|--------|------8-|--------|
G|--------|------8-|--------|5-6-7---|
D|------8-|--------|5-6-7---|--------|
A|--------|5-6-7---|--------|--------|
E|5-6-7---|--------|--------|--------|
Mode B example - code 1234
1+3: note 1 on the source; clear one string; notes 2-3-4 continue on the target.
e|--------|--------|--------|--6-7-8-|
B|--------|--------|--6-7-8-|--------|
G|--------|--6-7-8-|--------|5-------|
D|--6-7-8-|--------|5-------|--------|
A|--------|5-------|--------|--------|
E|5-------|--------|--------|--------|
FIRST PASS
Lightly accent landing note 4; verify the skipped string stays silent.
SECOND PASS
Remove the accent, equalize the notes, and keep the pick path compact.
Begin with separated four-note cells; connect the route only after every landing is quiet.
FIRST PASS
Lightly accent landing note 2; verify the skipped string stays silent.
SECOND PASS
Remove the accent, equalize the notes, and keep the pick path compact.
Begin with separated four-note cells; connect the route only after every landing is quiet.
Session protocol
1
Begin 8-12 BPM below your clean Level 5 tempo.
2
Session A: one 12-code set in Mode A. Session B: the same set in Mode B.
3
Play each exercise up and down, first with a downstroke start and then with an upstroke start.
4
After three clean loops, add 2 BPM next time. After two noisy skips,
errors, or tension, reduce 4-6 BPM.
5
Advance when both mode pages are clean on two separate days; then
alternate 3+1 and 1+3 between successive one-string-skip pairs.
Standard tuning. Fifth position. Preserve code order; skip one silent string after note 3 in Mode A or note 1 in Mode B.

L6-TXT1-1-23.text:
108 FINGER PERMUTATIONS - LEVEL 6: ODD-COUNT STRING-SKIP TRANSFER
3+1 / 1+3 gap control in standard tuning.
Fifth position: 1=index/fret 5, 2=middle/fret 6, 3=ring/fret 7, 4=pinky/fret 8.

MOVEMENT RULE
Mode A - 3+1 late skip: play digits 1-3 on the source string, clear one silent string, and land digit 4 on the target.
Mode B - 1+3 early skip: play digit 1 on the source string, clear one silent string, and continue digits 2-4 on the target.
Ascend through E-D, A-G, D-B, G-e. Descend through e-G, B-D, G-A, D-E.
The four-digit code order never changes. The physical string between source and target must remain silent.

WHY THIS IS LEVEL 6
Level 5 crossed the gap after note 2. Level 6 keeps the same one-string-skip distance but moves the crossing after note 3
or note 1. This combines the asymmetrical alternate-picking timing from Level 3 with the muting and landing demands of Level 5.

PRACTICE RULE
Begin 8-12 BPM below your clean Level 5 tempo. Use one 12-code set and one mode per session.
Play each exercise ascending and descending, once beginning with a downstroke and once beginning with an upstroke.
First pass: lightly accent the first note after the skip and verify that the middle string remains silent.
Second pass: remove the accent, equalize all four notes, and keep the pick path shallow and compact.
Start with separated four-note cells. Connect the complete route only after every landing is clean.
Rotate the existing straight-16th, triplet, and quintuplet groupings across sessions.
After three clean loops, add 2 BPM next time. After two noisy skips, errors, or rising tension, reduce 4-6 BPM.
Advance when both modes for the set are clean on two separate days. Then alternate 3+1 and 1+3 between successive skip pairs.
